summary.text: Tim Griffin is a Republican member of the Virginia House of Delegates, representing the 53rd District since January 10, 2024.
The district covers Amherst County, part of Bedford County and part of Nelson County.
The House profile lists Tim Griffin's occupation as attorney.

paragraphs.text: Tim Griffin was born in Huntsville, Alabama.
The profile lists a B.A. from Liberty University (2007) and a J.D. from the Appalachian School of Law (2011).
